summary: Planned iteration 1 for module `feedback` as a single greenfield delivery slice: bootstrap a Next.js TypeScript SaaS POC, establish a BFF layer, build the landing home page with required header/navigation/footer, add responsive accessibility polish, cover it with Playwright, and document delivery evidence. Evidence reviewed: `.ai_factory/docs/project-brief.md` identifies Next.js, TypeScript, and Playwright; `.ai_factory/delivery/intakes/3fee0f21-511f-4c78-a8b3-561d1098ba7c.md` requests the landing home page for `feedback`; prior readiness output records the clarified SaaS POC, professional OpenAI-inspired design, BFF layer, and no Git prerequisite. No tests were run during planning.

workItems.title: Bootstrap Next.js Application
workItems.description:
Create the greenfield Customer Feedback Portal application using Next.js and TypeScript with framework-native structure for the feedback module landing experience.

Acceptance criteria:
- A Next.js TypeScript app exists at the project root using framework-native routing and source conventions.
- Package scripts are present for development, build, linting, and Playwright test execution.
- The default home route renders without placeholder framework boilerplate.
- Dependencies: none.

workItems.title: Establish BFF Layer
workItems.description:
Add a backend-for-frontend foundation that can serve landing-page configuration and future feedback portal data without coupling the UI directly to static constants.

Acceptance criteria:
- A route handler or equivalent Next.js API endpoint exists for landing-page content/configuration.
- The home page consumes the BFF response through a typed client or server-side fetch pattern.
- Error and loading/fallback behavior are defined for the landing-page data path.
- Dependencies: bootstrap-nextjs-app.

workItems.title: Build SaaS Landing Home Page
workItems.description:
Implement a professional SaaS-inspired landing page for the feedback module using original placeholder content, inspired by modern OpenAI-style layout patterns without cloning third-party branding or protected copy.

Acceptance criteria:
- The home page includes a strong first-viewport hero for the Customer Feedback Portal/SaaS concept.
- Placeholder sections support future content replacement, such as value proposition, workflow highlights, insights/admin review, and call-to-action areas.
- The page uses a polished, responsive visual design suitable for a SaaS POC.
- No OpenAI trademarks, proprietary copy, or exact page cloning are used.
- Dependencies: bootstrap-nextjs-app, establish-bff-layer.

workItems.title: Add Header Navigation and Footer
workItems.description:
Provide the required top horizontal navigation, header, and footer for the landing page.

Acceptance criteria:
- A persistent header appears on the landing page with horizontal navigation links appropriate for a SaaS feedback portal POC.
- Navigation labels use placeholder-safe product language that can be refined later.
- A footer includes product, resource, and company-style link groups or equivalent SaaS footer content.
- Header and footer are responsive across desktop and mobile layouts.
- Dependencies: build-saas-landing-home.

workItems.title: Implement Responsive Accessible UI
workItems.description:
Ensure the landing page is usable and visually coherent across common viewports with accessible semantic structure.

Acceptance criteria:
- Layout is responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.
- Semantic landmarks are used for header, main content, navigation, and footer.
- Interactive elements have accessible names and keyboard-focus states.
- Text contrast and spacing support readable professional presentation.
- Dependencies: build-saas-landing-home, add-header-navigation-footer.

workItems.title: Add Playwright Landing Page Coverage
workItems.description:
Add functional browser coverage for the delivered landing-page experience following the project taxonomy test location guidance.

Acceptance criteria:
- Playwright is configured for the Next.js app.
- A functional test verifies the home page loads and key header, navigation, hero, and footer elements are visible.
- A responsive viewport check covers at least one mobile-sized rendering.
- Test files or evidence are placed under the AI Factory test structure where appropriate while respecting native framework conventions.
- Dependencies: build-saas-landing-home, add-header-navigation-footer, implement-responsive-accessible-ui.

workItems.title: Document Iteration Delivery Evidence
workItems.description:
Update delivery artifacts so the implemented iteration remains traceable to the intake, module, and taxonomy expectations.

Acceptance criteria:
- Relevant AI Factory documentation records the implemented feedback landing-page scope, technology choices, and BFF foundation.
- Delivery evidence references the intake `.ai_factory/delivery/intakes/3fee0f21-511f-4c78-a8b3-561d1098ba7c.md` and project brief `.ai_factory/docs/project-brief.md`.
- Test execution status is recorded truthfully, including any failures or unrun tests.
- Dependencies: add-playwright-coverage.
